title: Modern React & Next.js Masterclass: From Beginner to Pro

lessons.title: Introduction to React & Virtual DOM
lessons.description: Understand how React works under the hood with Virtual DOM diffing and component tree reconciliation.

lessons.title: Components, Props & State Management
lessons.description: Learn component breakdown, passing props, destructuring, and managing dynamic local state with useState.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the React Virtual DOM?
options: Directly manipulate browser DOM elements for speed
Maintain an in-memory representation to optimize actual DOM updates
Replace CSS styles dynamically in real-time
Compile JavaScript code into native C++
questions.correctAnswer: Maintain an in-memory representation to optimize actual DOM updates
questions.explanation: React compares Virtual DOM snapshots with reconciliation diffing to batch real DOM updates efficiently.

questions.question: Props passed to a React component are immutable and read-only inside that component.
questions.explanation: Components must never modify their own props directly.

questions.question: The React Hook used to declare state in functional components is called use_____
questions.explanation: useState is the hook used to manage reactive state.

lessons.title: Mastering useEffect & Side-Effects Lifecycle
lessons.description: Deep dive into dependencies array, cleanup functions, memory leak prevention, and custom hooks.

questions.question: When does the cleanup function returned by useEffect execute?
options: Before the component unmounts or before re-running the effect
Only when the browser window closes
questions.correctAnswer: Before the component unmounts or before re-running the effect
questions.explanation: The cleanup function handles subscriptions and timer clearing.
